corrections.reason: The printed glyph at the end of line 16 is clearly አዕ (አዕረፈት 'she passed away/rested'), not ዐዕ.

The printed word at the end of line 34 is ጊዜሆሙ (split across lines 34-35 as ጊዜ-ሆሙ, an archaic Ge'ez variant of ዚአሆሙ 'those two disciples of John'). The ligature/crowded type of ጊዜ at the right margin was misread as ዚ.
